icp.description: The ideal customer profile in plain words: industry, size, buyer, geography, business model, must-haves and exclusions.

item.description: The one company to judge, bound to this branch: a list-prepare slot {i, item_key, label, query} (fixed branches), a list-prepare accepted entry {index, item: {name, domain, ...}, item_key, query} (a for_each branch; the company is item.item), or a plain {name, domain?}. item_key is always top-level and copied unchanged into item_result.item_key. null means the slot is empty and the skill returns item_result.status skipped.

item_key.description: The stable identity key list-prepare gave this item; copied unchanged into item_result.item_key.

index.description: The accepted entry's slot index (for_each item).

item.description: In a list-prepare accepted entry: the company record as given, e.g. {name, domain}.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Optional: on JoyStream the template binds it to the run start time, and without it the skill uses the run start time from its instructions. Never guessed.
